title: A finite semilocal boundary detects divisibility of compatible normalized sections
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian Nagata integral domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], and let $x\in A$ be nonzero and not a unit. Assume $A$ is $(x)$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Fix a nonempty finite subset $\gamma_0\subset\operatorname{Max}A$, and let $\Gamma_0$ be all finite subsets $\gamma\subset\operatorname{Max}A$ containing $\gamma_0$. Put $A_\gamma=(A\setminus\bigcup_{\mathfrak m\in\gamma}\mathfrak m)^{-1}A$, the ring of fractions with denominators outside those maximal ideals, and $D_\gamma=\varprojlim_{j\ge1}A_\gamma/x^jA_\gamma$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Suppose primes $p_\gamma\subset D_\gamma$ satisfy $p_\gamma\cap A=(0)$ and the following compatibility: for $\gamma\subseteq\delta$, the inverse image of $p_\gamma$ under $D_\delta\to D_\gamma$ is $p_\delta$. Assume also $p_\gamma=p_\delta D_\gamma$ for every $\gamma\subseteq\delta$. Let $E_\gamma$ be the integral closure of $D_\gamma/p_\gamma$ in its fraction field [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. The injective quotient maps $D_\delta/p_\delta\to D_\gamma/p_\gamma$ extend to fraction fields and induce maps $E_\delta\to E_\gamma$. Define $T=\varprojlim_{\gamma\in\Gamma_0}E_\gamma$, explicitly the ring of tuples $(e_\gamma)_\gamma$ compatible with these maps. Suppose $\Delta=\bigcup_{\gamma\in\Gamma_0}\{Q\cap A:Q\text{ is prime minimal over }xE_\gamma\}$ is finite. Choose a finite set $\eta\in\Gamma_0$ such that for every $P\in\Delta$ there is $\mathfrak m\in\eta$ with $P\subseteq\mathfrak m$. Write $\pi_\eta:T\to E_\eta$ for tuple evaluation. For every integer $n\ge1$ and every $t\in T$, one has $\pi_\eta(t)\in x^nE_\eta$ if and only if $t\in x^nT$. Equivalently, $\pi_\eta^{-1}(x^nE_\eta)=x^nT$.
